outcome: Versioned agent, skill, tool, SCM, and CI catalogs are readable, projects and WorkItems can be updated and archived, admins persist a user directory with login audit, and moving a child between Milestones updates the parent plan
acceptance: a caller lists versioned agent, skill, tool, SCM, and CI catalogs
a project name and description can be updated
a project can be archived and restored
a WorkItem can be created and transitioned through versioned v1 APIs
a WorkItem can be archived and restored without a hard delete
an admin creates a user that still exists after the process reloads the directory
login, failed login, and logout write auth audit events
moving a child WorkItem between Milestones updates the parent plan and audit log
customers cannot manage the user directory or archive projects
inScope: versioned agent, skill, tool, SCM, and CI API groups
versioned WorkItem create, status, archive, and restore
parent-plan updates when a child changes Milestone
assumptions: board CRUD, admin user listing, and milestone assignment already exist
